assumptions.bar_execution: next supplied session open only; OHLC available only at session close; no original receipt/revision history
assumptions.fill: full; positive price rounded HALF_UP to cents
assumptions.metrics: initial equity plus each evaluation receipt/bar close; max drawdown from running peak; no annualization
assumptions.missing: no fabricated bars; windows span supplied completed candles
assumptions.receipt_execution: first later eligible receipt; duplicates/corrections not executable; stale/off-session quotes may fill
assumptions.sizing: one share when flat; close on down; no borrowing/shorting/pyramiding
assumptions.valuation: last positive known completed close, even if older than fill; unavailable if none; no forced liquidation

provenance.adjustments: as received; no adjustment or corporate-action model
